questions.questionText: In a dihybrid cross involving two genes located very closely on the same chromosome in Morgan's experiments on Drosophila:
options: Parental types were much higher in proportion than recombinant types
Recombinant types were much higher in proportion than parental types
Both parental and recombinant types were present in equal 50:50 proportion
Recombinant types were absent completely in all generations
questions.explanation: Morgan attributed this to physical association or linkage of the two genes and coined the term linkage. When two genes in a dihybrid cross are situated on the same chromosome, the proportion of parental gene combinations is much higher than the non-parental type.

questions.questionText: In a meter bridge experiment, the null point is obtained at 40 cm from the left end when a resistance of 10 Ω is connected in the left gap. The unknown resistance in the right gap is:
questions.explanation: For a meter bridge: R / S = l / (100 - l). Given R = 10 Ω and l = 40 cm. Thus 10 / S = 40 / (100 - 40) = 40 / 60 = 2 / 3 => S = (10 * 3) / 2 = 15 Ω.
